def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """
    Reverse elements while keeping each punctuation mark paired
    with its original element.
    """
    if len(elements) != len(punctuation):
        raise ValueError("elements and punctuation must have the same length")

    new_elements = elements[::-1]
    new_punctuation = punctuation[::-1]

    return new_elements, new_punctuation


# Example
elements = ["Hello", "world"]
punctuation = ["", "!"]

result = reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation)
print(result)
# (["world", "Hello"], ["!", ""])
